# Winged-Dash
[**Project Devlog 1**](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/youcef-belkhiri-80a8a6219_unity-machinelearning-ai-activity-7063887791746646016-Sf4Y?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) \
[**Project Devlog 2**](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/youcef-belkhiri-80a8a6219_unity-machinelearning-ai-activity-7076943425773678592-5dlX?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop) <br>
3D aircraft racing prototype against reinforcement learning (RL) agents achieving high cumulative rewards, built in Unity using the ML-Agents toolkit. Includes a 3D learning environment and integration of Imitative and Curriculum learning techniques. <br>

## Follow-up Project
This project served as the foundation for **[Galactic Domination](https://blastergames.itch.io/galactic-domination)**, a spaceship resource-gathering game developed for an AI Game Jam.  
The physics and flight controls from this prototype were extended and adapted to create Galactic Domination’s gameplay systems with extended mechanics.
